name: GoCraft
author: support@oreostudios.info
description: GoCraft — an experimental Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.4 and Bedrock Edition server implementation written in Go.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates git

BUILD_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "${BUILD_DIR}"' EXIT

echo "Cloning ${REPO_OWNER}/${REPO_NAME} (${BRANCH})..."
git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRANCH}" "https://github.com/${REPO_OWNER}/${REPO_NAME}.git" "${BUILD_DIR}"

cd "${BUILD_DIR}"
go mod download

echo "Building GoCraft for Linux amd64..."
CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=${BRANCH}" -o /mnt/server/gocraft .
chmod 755 /mnt/server/gocraft

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/server.yml ] && [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/server.yml" ]; then
  cp "${BUILD_DIR}/server.yml" /mnt/server/server.yml
fi

cd /mnt/server
./gocraft --version
echo "GoCraft installation complete."

variables.name: Repository Owner
variables.description: GitHub account or organization that owns the GoCraft repository.

variables.name: Repository Name
variables.description: GitHub repository containing the GoCraft source code.

variables.name: Branch or Tag
variables.description: Git branch or tag to clone and build during installation.

variables.name: Bedrock Port
variables.description: UDP port for the Bedrock listener. Assign the same port as an additional allocation in Pterodactyl.

variables.name: Enable Java Listener
variables.description: Whether to start the Minecraft Java Edition TCP listener.

variables.name: Enable Bedrock Listener
variables.description: Whether to start the Minecraft Bedrock Edition UDP listener.

variables.name: Java Online Mode
variables.description: Require Java Edition players to authenticate with Mojang.

variables.name: Bedrock Online Mode
variables.description: Require Bedrock Edition players to authenticate with Xbox Live.

variables.name: MOTD
variables.description: Message shown in the Minecraft server list.

variables.name: World Storage
variables.description: Choose disk for persistent Anvil storage or memory for an ephemeral world that is lost on restart.

variables.name: World Directory
variables.description: World directory relative to the server root when World Storage is disk.

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: Signed 64-bit seed for deterministic overworld terrain generation.

variables.name: Java View Distance
variables.description: Chunk radius sent to Java clients. Larger values use more bandwidth and memory.

variables.name: Pregeneration Radius
variables.description: Background chunk cache radius around players. Must be at least the Java view distance.

variables.name: Maximum Cached Chunks
variables.description: Maximum clean chunks retained in RAM. Lower this to reduce memory use at the cost of more disk reads or regeneration.
